desc:
🍎 🏨 🌙 
You have been hired to work the night shift at a fruit hotel, where you must welcome guests, check them in, and complete their room service requests.
But some of the guests don’t seem quite right...

👀 📸 🔑 
Watch the guests carefully and pay attention to everything they do.
Sometimes, the most normal-looking guest is the one you should be most suspicious of.
